title: About
lead:
Less noise. More you.
That's Tranquil Haven Coaching.
body:
Life doesn’t always fall apart in dramatic ways. Sometimes it simply becomes noisy.

You keep moving forward, caring for others, making decisions, meeting expectations – and somewhere between the long hours, constant responsibility, and life outside of work, you lose sight of yourself.

Hi, I’m Nina, founder of **Tranquil Haven Coaching**. I’m a psychology-informed coach helping healthcare professionals navigate burnout, compassion fatigue, career and relationship challenges, major life transitions, and those moments when something simply feels off – even when everything looks fine from the outside.

Alongside coaching, I work in the surgery department of a veterinary specialty hospital as part of a specialty surgical team managing everything from routine procedures to complex and critical cases.

Being part of that environment doesn’t make me a physician, but it has given me a firsthand understanding of long shifts, emergency cases, demanding schedules, teamwork, responsibility, and the emotional weight that comes with caring for others.

I do understand the emotional reality of caring professions and the culture of healthcare from the inside – without being your colleague, supervisor, or anyone you need to impress.

**You won’t have to spend half the conversation explaining why the job follows you home, why leaving isn’t always the answer, or why work you still care about can also leave you completely exhausted.**

Here, you don’t have to be the person who has the answers, keeps everyone calm, or holds everything together. You can talk honestly about your work, relationships, future, and the parts of yourself that may have gotten lost somewhere along the way.

My coaching is psychology-informed and grounded in the standards and ethics of the **International Coaching Federation (ICF)**. I won’t tell you what to do or who to become. I’ll help you challenge what no longer serves you, reconnect with your own strengths and values, and find clarity about what comes next.

Together, we’ll work through burnout, career challenges, relationship difficulties, major life transitions, and the questions that don’t fit neatly into a medical chart.

**Behind every healthcare professional is a person whose own life deserves just as much care and attention as the people they care for.**

Tranquil Haven was created to be exactly what its name suggests – a quiet place in the middle of a demanding profession.

A place to step away from the noise, reconnect with yourself, and focus on the person behind the professional role – so you can move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

Every conversation is confidential, respectful, and tailored to your unique circumstances.

Sessions are held online, allowing you to join from a place where you feel safe, comfortable, and fully yourself.

Because sometimes the most important journey isn't finding the right answer – it's finding yourself again.

You spend your life caring for others.

**This is a place where you can finally make space for yourself.**
note: Please note: Tranquil Haven Coaching provides coaching services only and does not provide psychotherapy, counseling, or mental health treatment.
